settings.heading:
A bed that becomes yours,
and stays that way.
settings.lede: Nothing is built before you order it. Thirty five centimetres, a seven-zone pocket sprung core guaranteed for twenty five years, and a comfort layer we remake to your preference for a year.
settings.cta_secondary: A year to settle the feel

settings.heading: Choose your size.
settings.body: Every size is the same build. Thirty five centimetres, seven-zone core, removable comfort layer. You do not choose a firmness.
settings.firmness_line: It arrives medium firm with a flippable comfort layer.

settings.heading:
What makes a mattress
still good in twenty years
settings.card_1_heading: You will not feel them turn over
settings.card_1_body: [Core] is two thousand springs, each sleeved on its own. One side of the bed does not travel to the other, so a partner getting up at six does not wake you at six.
settings.card_2_heading: Your spine stays straight all night
settings.card_2_body: Seven zones, two wire gauges. Heavier under the hips and shoulders where the weight lands, lighter at the waist and legs. You wake up the shape you should be rather than the shape the bed made you.
settings.card_3_heading: In year eight it is still your bed
settings.card_3_body: The top five centimetres are what soften. Ours lift out and are replaced for £299. The core underneath is guaranteed for twenty five years and never leaves the room.

settings.heading:
We did not copy
this from anyone.
settings.body_1: [Core] is ours. [Gel] is ours. [Cover] is ours. The two wire gauges and exactly where each one starts and stops, the flippable comfort layer, the wave-cut airflow profile, the zip that runs every side. Drawn here, argued over here, specified down to the density of every centimetre, and made to those drawings and no others.
settings.body_2: Most mattresses sold in this country are three or four builds wearing different covers. A brand picks one, chooses a fabric, names it something, and sells it to you as theirs. We did not want to sell you somebody else's bed with our name on it.
settings.pull: Nothing is built until you order it. Which is why the guarantee is twenty five years, and why you get a year to change how it feels.
settings.body_3: So you are not buying what was made last quarter and needs shifting before the next container lands. You are buying a bed that does not exist yet, built to a specification we own, assembled by hand, in the size you chose.

settings.kicker: Why you cannot choose in a showroom
settings.heading:
Four minutes lying down
tells you nothing.
settings.body_1: You cannot know how a mattress feels until you have slept on it for weeks. By then the decision is behind you and the money is spent, which is why most people keep a mattress they never liked.
settings.body_2: So you do not choose a firmness when you order. Your mattress arrives, you sleep on it, and for a year you tell us how it should feel. We build a new comfort layer to that description and send it, with our compliments.
settings.pull: You do not choose the feel. You discover it.

settings.heading: From £1,999.
settings.body: King is £2,999. Super King is £3,299. Every size is the same build, so the price is the size and nothing else.

settings.heading: It arrives finished.
settings.card_1_body: To the room you choose, unboxed, unrolled onto your bed and positioned. The packaging leaves with it.
settings.card_2_body: Taken away and sent for recycling. We carry the cost.
settings.card_3_body: We call before we come, and arrange a time that suits you. Nothing arrives unannounced.
settings.lede: Not left in a hallway in a box for you to wrestle upstairs.

settings.a1_body: A year to tell us how it should feel. We remake the comfort layer to that, with our compliments, as often as it takes.
settings.a2_body: Collected from your home and refunded in full. Emperor is made to order and excluded.
settings.a3_body: The part that carries you is guaranteed for a quarter of a century.
